problems: Round 1's blocker is fixed. Hesmi no longer glides when slowed. I measured the planted foot in the real renderer (render bench, real sim, fighter slowed or hasted to a set share of runRef, walking a straight 40 m on the North Road, 1/60 s frames). The measure is the foot's travel over each contact span divided by the body's travel, where a contact span is the lower foot within 3 cm of its lowest height for 4 or more frames. Hesmi: 7.0-9.6 % median at 0.40-0.66 runRef and 3.5-4.9 % at 1.0-1.7. Burdam: 2.2-4.3 % median. Ervet: 4.2-6.0 %. With the same HEAD code and the LIVE catalog (no walk clip), these four bodies give exactly the same numbers (Hesmi 7.6 / 7.0 / 7.4 / 6.8, Burdam 4.3 / 2.8 / 3.0 / 2.6, Ervet 4.8 / 4.2 / 4.8 / 4.3, Rishal 28.5 / 28.6 / 28.8 / 27.4). They now play live's code path, so this is the same as live.

NEW (missed in round 1): Burdam's menu lobby idle changed visibly. Ruling 68's budget step thinned every bone of Burdam's idle_lobby, victory, recall and channel to every second key (art/tools/decimate_chains.mjs with --prefix ''). Those tracks were already sparse, so the thinning removed hold ends and gesture peaks. For example, idle_lobby forearm.L went from 15 keys to 8: the hold key at 1.90 s and the 0.78 flex peak at 2.93 s are gone. Compared with live, the largest bone differences are: idle_lobby forearm.L 70 deg and hand.R 67 deg; victory forearm.R 77 deg; recall hand.R 55 deg. On the Home plinth, rendered side by side at the same frames on the live and HEAD catalogs, live Burdam raises the blade upright and inspects it. HEAD Burdam swings the blade flat across his chest instead. A Burdam player on Home would see this, and it reads worse than live. Rishal's and Ulkro's thinned menu loops (up to 29 deg and 36-48 deg on single bones) look the same on the plinth.

Ruling 70 leaves the hasted arm pump frozen on Hesmi, Burdam, Ervet and Rishal. locoPhase is advanced only in the walk branch of actors.ts, so on a body without walkRef it stays at 0. The LifeRig's haste pump (cos(TAU*phase)) then becomes a fixed +/-0.22 rad arm offset, and the taunt tug becomes a fixed pose on these four. It is small at the 31 m camera. Live has no haste layer at all, so the only cost is that these four get no pump. The fix is to advance locoPhase from the run action's time when walkRef is undefined.

CC reads at the 31 m RIFT match camera. I captured 4 rotations x 9 seats (Hesmi, Burdam, Kemdo, Lisvel, Rishal, Tunlan, Odrum, Ardit, Sukri; Sukri's seat did not render, so 8 fighters were scored), so every kind landed on at least 4 fighters at 0.15/0.4/0.7/1.1/1.6 s. Kinds: stun, airborne, sleep, fear, taunt, root, silence, disarm, slow. Every actor played the intended role with its layer weight at 0.86-1.0 by 0.4 s. Airborne reads clearly from the body (Burdam, Odrum, Rishal: lifted and splayed). Taunt reads moderately on open silhouettes (Ardit, Kemdo: chest forward, arms back). Fear reads weakly (Burdam and Odrum hunch with their forearms up; Lisvel seen from behind looks like a run). Stun reads through its ring and halo, and the body adds little. Sleep and root are nearly invisible on the body (Tunlan's hat and Hesmi's pack hide everything), so their plate and VFX carry them, as on live. Silence, disarm and slow have no body state, as ruled. Nothing reads worse than live, and no body or face is broken in any frame.

Line of action, checked with my own gltf-transform script on live (deploy) vs HEAD (dist-catalog) GLBs. On all 32 re-keyed clips, durations are unchanged and the pose at the 40 % impact is unchanged (0.0 deg on every rotation channel; Lisvel ult 1.6 deg). The wind-up changed (pre-impact max 6.5-22 deg per bone; Dunsom ult, Odrum ult and Lisvel attack1 0-0.4, as reported). The follow-through is compressed, which gives big post-impact differences (up to 154-177 deg on hands and weapons, for example Burdam attack1 and Ervet ult): a fast whip after contact, minor, as round 1 said. The FU-8 misses stand: Ervet ult and Lisvel attack1 have no counter-twist, and Ardit attack2 (0.96 m) and Rishal crit (0.76 m) are under the 1.2 m strike. probe_clip_line PASS.

Walk and blend on the twelve blending bodies (code unchanged in r2), in the renderer, contact-span median: Lisvel 4.9-7.2 %, Tunlan 4.8-9.3 %, Kemdo 2.6-6.2 % on the walk and 10-16 % in the blend band (its live run is 15-18 % at the same speeds, so this is better than live), Odrum 1.8-6.2 %, Dunsom 4.6-9.1 %. Ardit walks at 7-8.6 %, under the 10 % bar but above his live slowed run (3.3-4.1 %). Single contact spans reach 12-15 % at about 0.5 runRef on several bodies. probe_fighter_motion PASS (blend 'off (run only, as live)' on the four, pop ratio 0.64-1.2). I saw no glide and no pop through 0.55-0.65 or at 1.3.
